SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE, PLANS and PLAT OF SURVEY
No. 2294271

FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING AMENDMENT TYPE 1.
6925-39 N. SHERIDAN RD./ 1151-63 W. Morse Avenue
From a B3-1 to a B2-5

The subject property contains an existing one-story building,
formerly Leona’s restaurant, with an onsite and offsite parking lot.

The existing building and onsite parking will be demolished, the
existing offsite parking lot located at 1156 W. Farwell Avenue will
remain and will be utilized by the proposed. The character of the

surrounding area consists of 3 to 6-story multi-unit residential and
mixed-use buildings, a 6-story and a 9-story multi-unit mixed use
building within 2 blocks of the subject property.

The applicant seeks to rezone the subject property from a B3-1 Community
Shopping District to a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. The application
is for a Type one (1) Map Amendment so that the applicant may construct a 5-
story mixed-use building with commercial and 80 dwelling units with 16 rear
parking spaces onsite and 25 spaces at 1156 W. Farwell Avenue for a total of
41 spaces.

A separate application for a special use will be sought through the Chicago
Zoning Board of Appeals for the offsite parking lot.

The commercial space will be approximately 3,700 square feet.

This project will also be presented to the Chicago Plan Commission for the
Lakefront Protection Ordinance review.
